```sql
-- name: top_products
-- owner: merchandising
-- params: tenant_id, from, to, limit
-- Best sellers by units and revenue. Line items reference the variant by its
-- string id (integration feed), so it is cast when joining the catalog.
WITH paid_orders AS (
  SELECT o.id
    FROM orders o
   WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
     AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
     AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
     AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT pv.product_id, ol.order_id, pv.id AS variant_id,
         ol.quantity, ol.line_total_cents
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN paid_orders po      ON po.id = ol.order_id
    JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
),
per_order AS (
  SELECT product_id, order_id,
         sum(quantity)         AS qty,
         sum(line_total_cents) AS rev
    FROM lines
   GROUP BY product_id, order_id
),
per_product AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         count(*)  AS order_count,
         sum(qty)  AS quantity,
         sum(rev)  AS revenue_cents
    FROM per_order
   GROUP BY product_id
),
variant_counts AS (
  SELECT product_id, count(*) AS variant_count
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, variant_id FROM lines) dv
   GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       pp.order_count,
       pp.quantity,
       pp.revenue_cents,
       vc.variant_count
  FROM per_product pp
  JOIN variant_counts vc ON vc.product_id = pp.product_id
  JOIN products p        ON p.id = pp.product_id
 ORDER BY pp.quantity DESC, pp.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De orderfilter wordt eerst als aparte CTE uitgevoerd, zodat de dure joins alleen op relevante lines draaien. Distincte tellingen worden vervangen door twee-traps groepering (per order, daarna per product), en de zware productjoin met brede GROUP BY-sleutels verschuift naar na de aggregatie. Het resultaat blijft gelijk: `p.id` is primaire sleutel, dus de extra kolommen zijn functioneel afhankelijk en leveren dezelfde groepen op.
